import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants

def otherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool :=
  s.users.any (fun v => v != u && s.has v .admin)

def isValid (s : State) (r : Request) : Bool :=
  s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target && s.has r.actor .admin &&
    match r.op with
    | .grant => (r.actor != r.target) && !s.has r.target r.role
    | .revoke => s.has r.target r.role && (r.role != .admin || otherAdmin s r.target)

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if isValid s r then
    (.ok, { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r })
  else
    (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds  : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_authorization   : AdminOnly step := sorry
theorem req_no_self_grant   : NoSelfGrant step := sorry
theorem req_others_unchanged : OthersUnchanged step := sorry
theorem req_effects         : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_idempotency     : Idempotent step := sorry
theorem req_last_admin      : KeepsAdmin step := sorry

end Grants
